description: Straßenunterhaltung Krefeld is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.krzn.de. The WMS (Web Map Service) is a standardized interface for the provision of map sections in grid format. Requests can be sent to a WMS with various operations. Usually, this is done by a geoinformation system, in which the URL of the WMS is integrated. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Street Entertainment Krefeld" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
